About Us

Who We Are

South Sudan's dedicated technology consultancy for IT, cybersecurity, and data solutions.

RosTech Advisory is a South Sudan-based technology consultancy specializing in IT systems, cybersecurity, and data solutions. We work alongside NGOs, SMEs, and public institutions to help them navigate the digital landscape safely and effectively — without the overhead of large international firms.

Mission

Simplify & Secure Technology

To simplify and secure technology for organizations in South Sudan and East Africa — making digital tools accessible, safe, and impactful.

Vision

Leading Tech Advisory in East Africa

To become the leading technology advisory firm in East Africa — the trusted partner organizations turn to for locally-grounded expertise.

Values

Integrity, Impact, Innovation

We believe technology should serve people. We prioritize client outcomes and build relationships based on transparency and measurable results.

Ready to Work Together?

Talk to our team about your technology needs — free, with no commitment.

Case Studies

Real Results

How we've helped organizations across South Sudan transform through technology.

🏥 The Challenge

A Juba-based humanitarian NGO with 80+ staff had no formal cybersecurity policy. Staff used personal email for sensitive communications, and the organization suffered two phishing incidents in 2023, exposing donor data and internal records.

💡 Our Solution

RosTech conducted a full risk assessment, migrated the team to Google Workspace with enforced two-factor authentication, developed a tailored cybersecurity policy, and delivered a two-day staff awareness training program.

📈 Results

0
Phishing incidents in the 12 months following implementation
100%
Staff migrated to secure organizational email accounts
3×
Faster secure document sharing across field offices

📦 The Challenge

An SME in the logistics sector managed all operations through spreadsheets and WhatsApp. Monthly reporting took 3–5 days, and frequent data errors caused financial discrepancies that were difficult to trace or resolve.

💡 Our Solution

RosTech built a Power BI operations dashboard, automated weekly and monthly reports via scheduled email, and trained two internal staff to independently maintain the system going forward.

📈 Results

↓85%
Reduction in time spent preparing monthly management reports
Live
Real-time operational dashboard accessible to leadership daily
$0
Additional software costs — built on existing licensed tools

🌍 The Challenge

An M&E team collected program data on paper forms across five field locations. Data entry was slow and error-prone, and donor reports were regularly delayed — putting grant compliance at risk.

💡 Our Solution

We designed and deployed a KoBoToolbox system, trained 15 field enumerators, and built automated data pipelines feeding directly into reporting templates. Three months of post-deployment support was included.

📈 Results

↑90%
Improvement in overall data accuracy scores across field sites
2 days
Donor reports reduced from 2 weeks to 2 days
15
Field staff fully trained and self-sufficient on digital tools
